pages: Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, stands barefoot on the shingle holding one blunt net needle upright. Middle distance: the heaped green net, a coil of tarred twine, the iron ramp. Background: a fishing boat's hull, flat grey evening sea. Low sun on the water.

Hori, her father, a broad man of fifty with a grey moustache, in a navy jersey and rubber sea boots, crouches and pushes one fingertip into a square of green net mesh, the mesh drawn open wider than a hand. Middle distance: the headline laid straight along the pebbles, a wooden mallet. Background: wet shingle, evening light off the sea.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, kneels over the tear and counts the broken mesh edge bar by bar with one fingertip. Middle distance: the cut-back ends, a net needle, pale green twine. Background: rounded grey pebbles, low evening light, the sea beyond the shingle.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, passes one blunt needle through a loop of twine and pulls it tight, a second needle in her other hand. Middle distance: the spread net, twine coil, her knee on the pebbles. Background: wet shingle, light off the water.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, holds one flat brass mesh gauge edgeways to the mend and pushes it along. Middle distance: the closed mend, a net needle, green net heaped on the shingle. Background: wet pebbles, low evening light off flat water.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, holds the net up high and looks through one pale run of mesh, squares as wide as a jar neck. Middle distance: the brass mesh gauge in her fist, the mend below. Background: pebbles, evening light through the net.

Hori, her father, a broad man of fifty with a grey moustache, in a navy jersey and rubber sea boots, draws one short-bladed net knife through the opened run and the cut mesh falls away. Middle distance: a galvanised bucket, the loose cut length, the rest of the headline. Background: wet shingle, dimming evening light, flat grey sea behind.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, pulls one green half-mesh down into two wire hoops, twine in her teeth. Middle distance: a cord marked off in inches, moths at the lamp. Background: dark shingle, a deck lamp low over her shoulder, night coming.

Hori, her father, a broad man of fifty with a grey moustache, in a navy jersey and rubber sea boots, lays his thumb under one splice where the new mesh joins the old net. Middle distance: the net heaped in green folds, a brass scale pan. Background: the boat deck and rail, a flat grey horizon, cold morning light.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, lays one blunt net needle flat on the new mesh and walks it along, half a mesh at a time. Middle distance: the spliced join, her father's net book. Background: the deck, evening sun on the rail, calm water.

Anahera, a girl of sixteen with a dark plait, a rust-red wool jumper and a blue oilskin coat, sleeves pushed back, writes a small figure in pencil in the back of her father's net book. Middle distance: a pencil stub, the new mesh folded at her knee. Background: the deck rail, low evening light, grey water to a flat horizon.
